summary: Comprehensive Phase 1 frontend prototype testing of Qualister LIMS. Backend is only a placeholder /api/ health endpoint by design, so only frontend was tested (per review request). Covered all major flows: login+roles, sidebar visibility per role, access control, global search, notifications (6 items + dismiss + navigation), clients CRUD + detail, orders list + detail + 5-step new-order wizard, instruments list + add modal, certificate flagship flow (send-to-review from borrador, review approve+reject with mandatory reason validation, Corrección requerida banner on rejected cert + resend), standards, procedures, quality NC modal, finance (tabs + register payment), reports (12 report options + generate), users (new user modal), audit (row click opens drawer), settings (6 tabs + save state), language toggle ES->EN, dark mode toggle, logout. Approximately 55 test checks executed; all critical/expected checks PASS. No bugs found requiring main-agent action.

issues: toggle-language and toggle-theme buttons do NOT close the dropdown after click (setOpen(false) not called). Minor UX polish only — feature works.

action_items: (Optional polish) Close profile dropdown after clicking toggle-language or toggle-theme for smoother UX
(Optional) Consider persisting role in localStorage/sessionStorage so direct-URL access (page reload) doesn't force re-login — currently expected per prototype design, but would improve deep-linking.
critical_code_review_comments: Route protection via <Guard> is client-side only; for a real backend integration in Phase 2, endpoints must re-validate role permissions server-side.
AppContext state (role, certs, orders, users, etc.) is purely in-memory — expected for Phase 1 mock; state resets on hard reload (documented).
Certificates.jsx Ver action is a <button> with onClick nav, not an <a> — fine, but reduces middle-click/open-in-new-tab affordance for lists.
No lazy-loading / code-splitting on routes; entire app bundles together (acceptable for prototype).
test_credentials: Any credentials accepted; role via login-role-select (values: tecnico | jefe | finanzas | admin). File /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for this prototype.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Mock data in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js used as-is. In-memory additions (new client, new instrument, new user, payment, new order) worked correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flagship flows validated. Use SPA navigation via history.pushState + PopStateEvent to change routes without losing React-context role. Correct data-testids: send-to-review-button, confirm-send-review, approve-cert-button, reject-cert-button, confirm-reject-button, resend-review-button, wizard-create-button, save-client-button, save-instrument-button, save-user-button, user-name-input, user-email-input, register-payment-button, settings-save-button (NOT save-settings-button), tab-{key} for settings tabs, report-{key} for report items (12 reports), report-generated-message. Rejected cert detail banner text is 'Corrección requerida' (rendered uppercase via CSS).
